name: org.areweworking/are-we-working
title: Are We Working
description: Is a business open? Live Open, Partially open, Closed and emergency status, plus email alerts.

tools.name: get_business_status
tools.description: Returns the live operating status of a business on Are We Working: Open, Partially open, Closed, or an emergency status (Tornado Warning: Take Shelter Immediately, or Emergency Evacuation), with the business's note (for example a weather closure or delayed start) and when it was last updated. Use this to answer 'is X open / working today?'.

handle.description: The business's handle: the last part of its status page URL (areweworking.org/{handle}), e.g. 'riverside-fab'. Use search_businesses if you only know the name.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Searches businesses that have chosen to be discoverable on Are We Working, by name or handle. Returns each match's handle, city and state (to tell apart businesses with the same name), and current status. Businesses that are not listed will not appear here, but can still be looked up with get_business_status if you have their exact handle.

query.description: Part of the business name or handle.

tools.name: get_status_history
tools.description: Returns the most recent status changes for a business, newest first, each with the status, note, and time. Useful for 'when did it close?' or 'how often does this change?'.

handle.description: The business's handle: the last part of its status page URL (areweworking.org/{handle}), e.g. 'riverside-fab'. Use search_businesses if you only know the name.

tools.name: get_alert_signup_link
tools.description: Returns the business's status page link, where the person can tap 'Get alerts' to sign up themselves. Use this for TEXT alerts: text opt-in must be completed by the person on the web form, not by an agent. Text alerts may not be enabled yet.

handle.description: The business's handle: the last part of its status page URL (areweworking.org/{handle}), e.g. 'riverside-fab'. Use search_businesses if you only know the name.

tools.name: request_email_alerts
tools.description:
Signs a person up to receive an email whenever a business's status changes. IMPORTANT: only call this after the person has explicitly agreed to the consent text below, and give them the chance to read it first. Never call it on a person's behalf without that agreement. The request is not active immediately: a business administrator must approve it before any email is sent. Email only; for text alerts use get_alert_signup_link.

Consent text to show the person: "I agree to receive email alerts from Are We Working when this business's operating status changes. Message frequency varies. I can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any alert."

handle.description: The business's handle: the last part of its status page URL (areweworking.org/{handle}), e.g. 'riverside-fab'. Use search_businesses if you only know the name.

email.description: The person's email address, exactly as they gave it.

consent.description: Must be true, and only after the person has explicitly agreed to the consent text in this tool's description.
